title: Hadza Gut Diversity Reflects Fiber and Antibiotic Pressure
hook: A richer gut ecosystem follows very different food and medicine patterns.
closing: Diet and antibiotic exposure help explain why modern guts can lose microbial variety.
question: How much fiber did you eat?

segments.say: The Hadza carry about 730 gut bacteria species. Their microbiome holds far more variety than the average American's.
The Hadza eat 150 grams of fiber daily. That fuel helps sustain the richer gut community shown before.
Thirty-four percent of US outpatient antibiotic prescriptions were likely unnecessary. That is another pressure on the diversity the first beat counted.
